after_copy_lease_contract.current_target_read: owner_v2 reads g->owner after mcs_event_end; this is safe only because g/config/SourceTCB are immutable and pinned throughout that interval and POST/full callback return.
after_copy_lease_contract.future_mutable_owner_requirement: Capture target/generation while holding the admission lease; independently pin that exact TCB/guard/component until POST returns, revalidate queued identity, and reject any owner-republish race. Capturing alone does not keep a freed TCB alive.
after_copy_lease_contract.stale_Stop_wake: Stop between end and explicitPOST closes admission/increments queue epoch and can discard pending copies; Source consumes a harmless stale event and refuses stopped data. Target remains valid because TCB is resident.
after_copy_lease_contract.release_internal_wake: umc_media_release and callback_release can themselves wake Source when STOPPING, potentially between the two releases. Zero-counter assertions therefore apply to successful ARMED first-start, not arbitrary Stop interleavings.
after_copy_lease_contract.lost_wake_argument: Copied queue publication precedes POST. OriginalPOST merges 0x80000 into TCB+4 and originalWAIT observes the mailbox; event coalescing is level notification of queue work, not one wake per packet.
after_copy_lease_contract.queued_data_not_live: Coherence rejection after publication may retain copied pending bytes without a POST; stopped/replaced epoch/admission must deny decode. This is not a dangling caller buffer.
after_copy_lease_contract.callback_reference_semantics: The ingress media/callback counters cover copied-input processing, not every instruction until original native callback return after the new early release.
after_copy_lease_contract.independent_lifetime_pin: Module RX/data, guard/config, queue buffers, Source TCB/stack and native foreign caller stack remain resident until full returns. No current unload/STOP_DONE API may treat these counters as reclamation evidence.
